name: v14_earnings_news_slow_cash_quality
hypothesis: v13 earnings news impact was strong but too high turnover. Increase decay and lower news weight while keeping cashflow quality.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Primary target: reduce turnover below 25% while preserving the v13 earnings-news signal.

name: v14_earnings_news_slow_goodwill_quality
hypothesis: Earnings-news impact may diversify better when anchored by the newly validated low-goodwill quality branch.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * goodwill / assets, 126), industry)
notes: Uses mL8j98w9 mechanism as slow anchor; watch correlation with mL8j98w9 and RRpmOAWj.

name: v14_earnings_css_slow_cash_quality
hypothesis: Composite sentiment score may be smoother than news-impact projection and therefore lower turnover.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_css_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests a smoother Ravenpack earnings field.

name: v14_earnings_news_no_reversal_cash_goodwill
hypothesis: If the intraday reversal component drives turnover and correlation, remove it and combine two slow anchors.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * goodwill / assets, 126), industry)
notes: No close/open reversal; may reduce correlation but could lower Sharpe.

name: v14_earnings_news_long_window_cash_quality
hypothesis: A longer earnings-news ranking window should smooth event noise and reduce turnover.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 126), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry)

name: v14_earnings_news_low_trunc_cash_quality
hypothesis: Lower truncation may reduce concentrated news-event exposure while preserving the signal.
expression: 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(rp_nip_earnings, 90), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(cashflow_op / assets, 126), subindustry)
notes: Tests whether lower truncation improves stability and sub-universe behavior.
